title: Gemini UFO audio and airbrushed UFO in NASA textbook
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Gemini UFO audio and airbrushed UFO in NASA textbook, about 1960s at Earth orbit; NASA, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then in the they have this um book actually, the Simpkinson uh textbook that shout out to my buddy Chris Ramsay from the great show Area 52.

related.note: Both are about the UFO image in the Simpkinson Gemini material. This telling says a real UFO was airbrushed into or shown in the textbook, while Knuth's story says the original photo has no UFO and the image is a mock-up.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the 1960s Gemini missions, NASA's early two-man spaceflights, and says there is audio of a UFO from them. He also points to a book he calls the Simpkinson textbook, which the story says shows a UFO that was airbrushed out, and credits his friend Chris Ramsay, host of a show called Area 52, for finding it. If true, it would mean NASA saw something in orbit and edited it out of the record.
